name: productivity
description: Skills for individual AI-assisted knowledge work. ai-writing-audit: check a draft for the signs of AI authorship and rewrite so it reads as a person wrote it. portable-markdown: write markdown a person will open in a desktop editor — Typora, Obsidian, a plain viewer — so the links land on the right thing and no raw markup shows. Works in any Claude Code or Cowork session, and can be consumed by an automated pipeline from the same source.
